quick_style.name: Quick style
quick_style.info: The four settings that change the look of every page. The color sets below hold the rest.

colors_light.name: Colors: light background
colors_light.info: Used when Background is Light, and for inverse sections on a dark page.

colors_dark.name: Colors: dark background
colors_dark.info: Used when Background is Dark, and for inverse sections on a light page.

colors_overrides.info: Leave these empty and the theme picks colors that stay readable (4.5:1 contrast for text). Set one only to match exact brand colors.

success.label: Free gift badge
success.info: Used for FREE GIFT badges. The text color is picked for contrast.

heading_tracking.label: Heading letter spacing
heading_tracking.info: In hundredths of an em. Negative values tighten headings.

section_spacing.label: Space between sections
section_spacing.info: Desktop spacing. Phones use about two thirds of it.

reveal_on_scroll.label: Reveal sections on scroll
reveal_on_scroll.info: Off for visitors who ask their device for reduced motion.

robots.label: Search engines on pre-landers
robots.info: Pre-landers are for ad traffic, so they are hidden from search by default. A page's blueprint.robots metafield overrides this.

buy_box.name: Buy box
buy_box.info: How bundle tiers show savings. Savings are always rounded down so they are never overstated.

savings_reference.label: Measure savings against
savings_reference.info: Only use compare-at prices that are genuine regular prices.
savings_reference.auto: Compare-at price when set, otherwise buying singles

show_per_month.label: Lead with the monthly price on multi-month tiers
show_per_month.info: Uses the product's blueprint.days_per_unit metafield (default 30 days per unit).

rewards.info: Up to three rewards unlocked by cart value. Create a matching automatic discount in Shopify for each one (free shipping over the amount; Buy X Get Y for a gift), or the reward won't apply at checkout.
rewards.threshold_info: Cart value in your store currency, after discounts. Gifts and shipping protection don't count. Leave blank to turn this reward off.
rewards.gift_info: Added automatically when the reward unlocks and removed below it. Shoppers can remove it.

currencies.label: Thresholds in other currencies
currencies.info: One line per currency, for example EUR: 45, 120, 180. The bar is hidden for currencies without a line, so it never shows a converted guess.

protection.product_info: A product you create, for example $2.95 with no shipping required. Hide it from search. Leave blank to turn protection off.
protection.default: Add it to carts by default
protection.default_info: Off is recommended: pre-checked protection is the subject of a 2026 class action alleging hidden fees. If on, it's added once per cart and never re-added after a shopper removes it.

upsell.info: From the first item's blueprint.upsell metafield, otherwise the collection below. Products already in the cart are skipped.
upsell.show_deal_info: Shows the upsell product's blueprint.cart_deal_label (for example "$18 in cart"). Only turn on with a matching automatic discount.

checkout.dynamic_info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay and others. They load extra scripts and slow the cart down.

empty.info: Up to three products shown when the cart is empty.

heading_tag.label: Heading tag
heading_tag.info: For search engines and screen readers. Use H1 once per page.

custom_class.label: Custom CSS class
custom_class.info: For styles added through the theme editor's custom CSS.

product.label: Product
product.info: On a product page, leave blank to use that product.

use_metafield.label: Use the product's metafield when it has one

hide_empty.label: Hide when there is nothing to show

sticky.label: Stick to the top on scroll

settings.info: Add your profile links in Theme settings > Social media.

disclosure.label: Disclosure
disclosure.info: Advertorials should say they are advertising.

sticky_info.label: Keep product info in view on desktop

product.label: Product
product.info: Its review rating shows next to the buttons, and buttons can add its price. Buttons without a link go to it.

note.label: Note next to the buttons
note.info: Short text, for example "Free shipping on 3+".

marquee.label: Scroll as a marquee
marquee.info: Stops for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

name.label: Name
name.info: Shown as text when there is no logo, and as the logo's alt text.

settings.reads_the_product_s_blueprint_certificat: Reads the product's blueprint.certifications metafield first, then the badges below.

settings.reads_the_product_s_blueprint_benefits_m: Reads the product's blueprint.benefits metafield first, then the benefits below.

source.label: Source
source.info: Name the study, journal or lab. Results without a source shouldn't be shown.

settings.reads_the_product_s_blueprint_studies_me: Reads the product's blueprint.studies metafield first, then the results below.

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.info: Percentages draw a bar or ring.

show_why.label: Show what each one is for

footer_link.label: Footer link
footer_link.info: The product's blueprint.coa file is used when it has one.

settings.reads_the_product_s_blueprint_ingredient: Reads the product's blueprint.ingredients metafield first, then the rows below.

us_label.label: Your column
us_label.info: Leave blank for your store name.

settings.only_compare_things_you_can_back_up_read: Only compare things you can back up. Reads the product's blueprint.comparison metafield first, then the rows below.

us.label: Yours
us.info: yes or no for a check or a cross, or short text.

them.label: Theirs
them.info: yes or no for a check or a cross, or short text.

product.label: Product
product.info: Prices and the saving come from its selling plans. On a product page, leave blank to use that product.

button_link.label: Button link
button_link.info: Leave blank to open the product with subscribe selected.

show_summary.label: Show the rating summary
show_summary.info: From the product's reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields (set by most review apps). Hidden when there is none.

product.label: Product
product.info: Whose rating to summarize. On a product page, leave blank to use that product.

settings.only_quote_real_reviews_word_for_word_to: Only quote real reviews, word for word. To show reviews straight from a reviews app, add its app block.

structured_data.label: Add FAQ structured data for search engines
structured_data.info: Turn off if another FAQ on the page already adds it.

settings.reads_the_product_s_blueprint_faqs_metaf: Reads the product's blueprint.faqs metafield first, then the questions below.

days.label: Days in the badge
days.info: Leave blank to show the icon instead.

settings.reads_the_product_s_blueprint_guarantee_: Reads the product's blueprint.guarantee metafield first.

settings.pauses_on_hover_and_focus_and_stays_stil: Pauses on hover and focus, and stays still for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

animate.label: Count up when scrolled into view
animate.info: Shows the final number straight away for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

value.label: Value
value.info: Only use numbers you can back up, for example 92, 4.9 or 41,208.

autoplay.label: Play muted when scrolled into view
autoplay.info: Uploaded videos only. Never plays for shoppers who prefer reduced motion; tap to hear sound.

video.label: Video
video.info: Upload a short clip, or use a YouTube or Vimeo link below.

video_url.label: Or a YouTube or Vimeo link

poster.label: Cover image
poster.info: Shown before a linked video plays.

settings.only_post_customer_content_you_have_perm: Only post customer content you have permission to use. A UGC app's block can replace the tiles.

settings.copy_real_customer_comments_word_for_wor: Copy real customer comments word for word, from your own posts or reviews. Never write them yourself.

likes.label: Likes
likes.info: The count from the original post, for example 1.2K. Leave blank to hide.

caption.label: Caption
caption.info: Say whose photos these are and that they are unedited.

options.fixed: A fixed end date and time
options.evergreen: A time after each visitor arrives

end.label: End date and time
end.info: For example 2026-11-30 23:59 -0500 (date, time, time zone). Make it the real end of the offer.

evergreen_hours.label: Hours per visitor
evergreen_hours.info: Only use this when the offer really is per visitor (for example a first-visit code). A timer that resets for everyone misleads shoppers.

settings.add_a_question_then_its_answers_up_to_fo: Add a Question, then its Answers. Up to four questions. Each answer can lead to a product or a link; the last answer chosen decides the result. Without JavaScript, answers on the first question link straight to their result.

params.label: Link parameters
params.info: Added to the result link, for example tier=2&plan=sub to preselect a bundle.

discount_percent.label: Bundle discount shown
discount_percent.info: Display only: create an automatic discount with the same percentage and minimum quantity, or shoppers will see a saving checkout doesn't give. 0 hides the saving.

collection.label: Products from a collection
collection.info: Used when no products are added as blocks.

show_box.label: Put the text on a panel
show_box.info: Keeps text readable on any photo.

autoplay.label: Change slides automatically
autoplay.info: With a pause button. Stays still for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.

fallback_title.label: Title before a collection is chosen

note.label: Small print
note.info: Only promise what you send, for example a code you really email.

image.label: Image
image.info: Leave blank to use the collection's image.

fallback_title.label: Title before a collection is chosen

video_url.label: Or a YouTube or Vimeo link

autoplay.label: Play muted when scrolled into view
autoplay.info: Uploaded videos only, never under reduced motion.

custom_liquid.label: Custom Liquid
custom_liquid.info: Add app snippets or other Liquid code.

product.label: Product
product.info: On a product page, leave blank to use that product.

show_disclosure.label: Show the advertising disclosure
show_disclosure.info: Paid or affiliate content needs a clear disclosure (FTC native-advertising guidance). Turning it off shows a warning in the editor.

role.label: Role
role.info: For example "Nutritionist" or "Customer since 2024". Say if the author was paid.

date.label: Date
date.info: Leave blank for the page's publish date.

read_time.label: Minutes to read
read_time.info: Leave blank to estimate from the page content.

cta_product.label: Product
cta_product.info: The button opens this product with the tier and plan below already chosen.

cta_tier.label: Tier
cta_tier.info: 0 keeps the product's own default tier.

cta_link.label: Or a link
cta_link.info: Used when no product is chosen.

cta_product.label: Product
cta_product.info: The button opens this product with the tier and plan below already chosen.

cta_tier.label: Tier
cta_tier.info: 0 keeps the product's own default tier.

cta_link.label: Or a link
cta_link.info: Used when no product is chosen.

cta_product.label: Product
cta_product.info: The button opens this product with the tier and plan below already chosen.

cta_tier.label: Tier
cta_tier.info: 0 keeps the product's own default tier.

cta_link.label: Or a link
cta_link.info: Used when no product is chosen.

sticky_first.label: Keep the first column in view while scrolling on mobile

settings.only_compare_what_you_can_back_up_and_ke: Only compare what you can back up, and keep competitor facts current.

cell_1.label: Column 1
cell_1.info: yes or no for a check or a cross, or short text.

cell_2.label: Column 2
cell_2.info: yes or no for a check or a cross, or short text.

cell_3.label: Column 3
cell_3.info: yes or no for a check or a cross, or short text.

cell_4.label: Column 4
cell_4.info: yes or no for a check or a cross, or short text.

default_tier.label: Start on tier
default_tier.info: 0 keeps the product's own default. A link with ?variant= still wins.

options.offer: The offer section on this page

text.label: Text
text.info: Leave blank for the product's title.

cta_product.label: Product
cta_product.info: The button opens this product with the tier and plan below already chosen.

cta_tier.label: Tier
cta_tier.info: 0 keeps the product's own default tier.

cta_link.label: Or a link
cta_link.info: Used when no product is chosen.

hide_over_offer.label: Hide while the offer is on screen

show_filters.label: Show filters
show_filters.info: Set filters up in the Search & Discovery app.

pill_filter_label.label: Quick filter
pill_filter_label.info: The filter shown as pills, by its name (for example "Product type"). Leave blank for the first list filter.

settings.info: Reads Shopify's standard review fields (reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count), which Judge.me, Loox, Yotpo and most review apps fill in. Shows nothing until a product has reviews.
Honest data only: shows the number an integration writes to the product's blueprint.live_viewers metafield. The theme never estimates or invents viewers.

text.label: Award
text.info: Only list awards the product has actually won.

show_savings.label: Show savings
show_savings.info: Savings are rounded down and measured as set in Theme settings > Buy box.

settings.info: Uses the product's blueprint.benefits metafield when it has one, so each product shows its own benefits. Otherwise shows the benefits added here.
Real inventory only: shows a low-stock count when Shopify tracks the variant and stops selling at zero.

Shows when the product has selling plans from a subscription app (for example the free Shopify Subscriptions app). The saving comes from the plan itself. If a subscription app's own widget is on the page, remove this block so plans aren't chosen twice.

label.label: Button label
label.info: Leave empty for "Add to cart" in the store's language.

show_price.label: Show the price on the button

show_dynamic_checkout.label: Show dynamic checkout buttons
show_dynamic_checkout.info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay and others. They load extra scripts, so turning them off speeds up the page.

text.label: Text
text.info: The product's blueprint.guarantee metafield takes precedence.

settings.info: Shows only when both the statistic and its source are filled in.
Shows the payment methods enabled in Settings > Payments.
"Bought today" is real data only: it reads blueprint.sold_today and shows it only when blueprint.sold_today_date is today. The setup guide includes a Shopify Flow template that keeps both up to date.
Counts down to your real daily dispatch cutoff in the store's time zone, skipping weekends. No reset tricks.

hide_pack_option.label: Hide the pack option
hide_pack_option.info: The pack option (blueprint.pack_option, default "Pack") is chosen with the bundle tiers instead.

swatches.label: Show color swatches
swatches.info: Uses the swatch colors and images set on option values in Shopify.

settings.info: Describes a gift that comes with every order. Gifts tied to a bundle tier show on that tier instead. Set up the matching automatic discount in Discounts.

content.label: Content
content.info: Used when no page is chosen.

settings.info: Appears once the add-to-cart button scrolls out of view. Fixed at the bottom of the screen, so it never shifts the page.

custom_liquid.label: Custom Liquid
custom_liquid.info: Add app snippets or other Liquid code.

settings.info: Hidden when the product has bundle tiers, because the tier sets the quantity.

tag_prefix.label: Tag prefix
tag_prefix.info: Tags that start with this prefix show as labels. For example, the tag "label:Vegan" shows "Vegan".

settings.info: Shows when local pickup is set up for a location that stocks this variant.
Shows the product in the blueprint.upsell metafield.
Tiers come from the product's blueprint.tiers metafield, or from the values of its Pack option. Prices always come from the tier's variant, so the box, cart and checkout match.

serving_label.label: Unit name
serving_label.info: Used in "$2.63 / serving". The product's blueprint.serving_label metafield takes precedence.
